sources.title: MS-Marco-MiniLM-L-12-v2 - GitHub
sources.snippet: MS-Marco-MiniLM-L-12-v2 This model was trained on the MS Marco Passage Ranking task. The model can be used for Information Retrieval: Given a query, encode the query will all possible passages (e.g. retrieved with ElasticSearch). Then sort the passages in a decreasing order. See SBERT.net Retrieve & Re-rank for more details.

sources.title: Ms Marco Minilm L12 - The GTM Directory
sources.snippet: MS MARCO MiniLM-L12 v2 is an open-weight cross-encoder reranker fine-tuned on the MS MARCO Passage Ranking dataset, designed to score query-passage pairs in the second stage of retrieval pipelines. Its 12-layer MiniLM backbone keeps the parameter count at 33.4M, processing roughly 960 documents per second on a V100.
